say:0:1510649001:0.text: I can't believe such a magnificent building is just an altar.
say:0:1510649001:0.source_cn: 这么宏伟的建筑居然只是一座祭坛。
say:0:1510649001:0.male: I can't believe such a magnificent building is just an altar.
say:0:1510649001:0.female: I can't believe such a magnificent building is just an altar.

say:1:1510649002:0.text: The God of Harvest once favored Tuttleton with golden fields.
say:1:1510649002:0.source_cn: 所以丰饶神格外眷顾图塔镇，让这里以金色麦乡闻名……曾经。
